notes: The database is created automatically when the backend starts if it does not exist.
PRAGMA user_version tracks the schema version; older databases are migrated on startup. Version 1 had no user_version.
A demo user (user / password) is seeded with one board; registered users get a starter board.
All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 strings.

columns.username: TEXT not null, unique, COLLATE NOCASE
columns.display_name: TEXT not null, default ''; the UI falls back to the username
columns.password_hash: TEXT not null; scrypt$<salt hex>$<digest hex>

sessions.purpose: Signed-in browser sessions; the raw token lives only in the pm_session cookie.

columns.token_hash: TEXT primary key; SHA-256 of the session token
columns.user_id: TEXT not null, references users(id) on delete cascade
columns.expires_at: TEXT not null; 30 days after creation

boards.purpose: A Kanban board owned by one user; a user may own many.

columns.user_id: TEXT not null, references users(id) on delete cascade
columns.name: TEXT not null
columns.updated_at: TEXT not null; bumped by every board, column, or card change

columns.board_id: TEXT not null, references boards(id) on delete cascade
columns.title: TEXT not null
columns.position: INTEGER not null; 0-based, unique per board

cards.purpose: Work items, ordered within a column.

columns.board_id: TEXT not null, references boards(id) on delete cascade
columns.title: TEXT not null
columns.priority: TEXT not null, default 'none'; one of none, low, medium, high
columns.position: INTEGER not null; 0-based, unique per column

constraints: FOREIGN KEY(board_id, column_id) REFERENCES columns(board_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
